questions.expl: Sekizgeni bir kareden köşeleri kesilmiş olarak düşün. Köşe üçgenleri ikizkenar dik, hipotenüs 2 → dik kenar √2. Kare kenarı 2 + 2√2. Alan (2 + 2√2)² − 4 · (√2 · √2)/2 = (4 + 8√2 + 8) − 4 = 8 + 8√2.

choices: The student who studied the most hours had the highest score.
Every student who studied more than 7 hours scored higher than 80.
The median number of hours studied was 5.5.
For every pair of students, the one who studied more hours had the higher score.
